message:
Using `on:longpress` to listen to the longpress event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onlongpress` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:mouseenter` to listen to the mouseenter event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onmouseenter` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

`pressed` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update

`duration` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
